release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.2

• **PC (Windows) 1080p/720p Official Music Videos**: Powered Windows video playback with D3D11/FFmpeg hardware decoding so Official Music Videos stream in 1080p/720p HD instead of 360p, and enabled Live Animated Covers (.m3u8) on Windows.
• **Android Downloads Fixed Across Android 8–16**: Fixed native ConnectivityManager Wi-Fi detection, Scoped Storage / write-verified fallback directories, lifecycle interruption (screen-off/app-switch no longer cancels active downloads), and paused download visibility with one-tap resume.
• **Faster Settings & Smooth Android Discord RPC Login**: Replaced translucent dialog WebView compositing with an opaque full-screen login route, cached Settings async status futures, and lazy-rendered Settings search results.
• **Listen Together Disabled for This Update**: The Coming Soon Listen Together button in the bottom player bar matches Settings and shows an unavailable notice.
